title: Flutter Mane 043/131 Reverse Holo Pokeball Pattern Prismatic Evolutions Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Flutter Mane 043/131 Reverse Holo Pokeball Pattern Prismatic Evolutions Pokemon card is a rare collectible card from the Pokémon TCG series. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2025, this card features the Psychic attribute with the character Flutter Mane illustrated by Kodama. Made from standard card stock, this English-language card is a sought-after addition for Pokémon collectors and fans of the game.
